summary: P2 retest after fixes: all 3 previously-reported HIGH bugs are confirmed fixed. 19/19 backend tests pass (100%). All 7 frontend verification items pass. App loads cleanly with no TDZ crash, /me returns decrypted email, admin/users shows 2 users with readable emails (no duplicate admin), no screenshot-protected class for admin, no blur overlay, sessionStorage tokens correct, Community Board URLs clickable and posts within card margins.

minor.issue: Email search (@-containing queries) uses ONLY email_hash lookup. Legacy users created BEFORE P2 encryption (e.g., TEST_P1_BanUser) have no email_hash and cannot be found by email search. Noted from previous iteration - still unresolved but low impact.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add plaintext email fallback in network search for legacy users without email_hash (test_banuser_p1@example.com cannot be found by email search)
critical_code_review_comments: All 3 P2 HIGH bugs from iteration_37 are confirmed fixed: (1) /me email decryption in auth.py get_me() - FIXED (safe_decrypt called on line 270), (2) server.py seeding duplicate admin - FIXED (email_hash lookup on lines 131-134), (3) AuthContext.js TDZ crash - FIXED (logout declared before useEffect).
Admin Dashboard correctly shows 2 users with decrypted emails: Bob (deathproofrebel@protonmail.com) and TEST_P1_BanUser. No duplicate Admin user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P2 fixes all verified. DB has exactly 2 users: Bob (admin, encrypted email, email_hash set) and TEST_P1_BanUser (plaintext email, no email_hash - pre-P2 migration). The only remaining minor issue is that legacy users without email_hash cannot be found by email in network search - fallback to plaintext email needed in search. All other P2 features (session tokens in sessionStorage, screenshot prevention for non-admins, auto-logout on tab hide, Community Board linkify, Admin Dashboard decrypted emails) are working correctly.
